info.name: RETFound local image prediction
info.description: Use Postman Desktop or the web app with Desktop Agent. Start run_web.bat, send Health, then open Predict image > Body > form-data and select a local file for image. Do not manually set Content-Type: Postman supplies the multipart boundary. Images go only to the local RETFound server.

request.description: Select a retinal fundus image. New images go directly to the real model with no prior approval. The model does not detect non-retinal images. Maximum 20 MiB. Leave Content-Type unset so Postman creates the boundary.

formdata.description: Select a local JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP or WebP file.

exec: pm.test('Prediction or image validation error', () => pm.expect([200, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('Five finite scores', () => { pm.expect(result.scores).to.have.lengthOf(5); result.scores.forEach(s => pm.expect(Number.isFinite(s) && s >= 0 && s <= 1).to.eql(true)); });
pm.test('Scores sum to one', () => pm.expect(result.scores.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0)).to.be.closeTo(1, 0.000001));
pm.test('No disease grade for a rejected input', () => { pm.expect(result).not.to.have.property('predicted_grade'); pm.expect(result).not.to.have.property('scores'); });
